usage_notes.app_icon: Use golden_star_connected_nodes or primary_holographic_star_reel at 1024x1024 as the master icon.
usage_notes.navbar: Use compact square icon plus wordmark from the web exports; avoid tiny detailed versions below 32px.
usage_notes.footer: Use the horizontal web export at 320px or 480px width.
usage_notes.splash_screen: Use the 4K square version centered on a deep black/purple gradient background.
usage_notes.favicon: Use the included .ico files or 32x32/48x48 PNG exports.
